text:
They don't know anything. We went a few times before it was finally sorted. One of the unsuccessful times, I asked to see where the law says the conversion is 5 years from the first time ever being in Israel (I was born here, but moved abroad), she says I can go to the Knesset to find it. They make stuff up! 

Holon is where we finally found a normal clerk. 

Good luck!
